faq.subtitle: The questions everyone asks (and the answers that'll save you time)

items.q: What does ‘KokoFresh’ mean for your masalas?
items.a: Freshness is our promise. We grind spices in small batches and label each pack with the Date of Blending so you always enjoy pure, aromatic flavor.

items.q: How fast is delivery across India?
items.a: We deliver anywhere in India within 2–4 business days. Orders above ₹500 get free shipping, so your favorite spices reach you faster.

items.q: Are your spices organic and where are they sourced from?
items.a: Our spices come from trusted partner farms that follow clean and sustainable farming. We believe in honest, farm-to-packet freshness.

items.q: Do you supply for restaurants or bulk orders?
items.a: Yes! We love partnering with chefs, cafes, and caterers. Just write to us at help@kokofresh.in for bulk orders or quotes.

items.q: Are your masalas free from artificial colours and preservatives?
items.a: Absolutely. Our promise is 100% pure, natural spices. We never add artificial colours, preservatives, or fillers. What you get is just the authentic, unadulterated flavour of premium quality ingredients.

items.q: How should I store my spices to maintain their freshness?
items.a: For the best aroma and potency, store your KokoFresh masalas in a cool, dark, and dry place away from direct sunlight. Our resealable packs are designed to lock in freshness, but an airtight container is always ideal.

cta.body: Don’t be shy! We love talking about spices almost as much as we love making them. Reach out and let’s start a conversation.
